name: Raven's Crossing
description: A coastal New England town where generations of secrets are buried beneath the surface.
seed_prompt: A classic mystery setting where amateur sleuths and professional investigators unravel complex crimes.
lore_content:
Raven's Crossing, Maine, population 8,000, sits where the Penobscot River meets the Atlantic. The founding families still control most of the town's wealth, and they've kept their secrets for three hundred years.

Chief Detective Sarah McAllister returned to her hometown after fifteen years with the Boston PD. She thought small-town crime would be simpler. Then bodies started appearing with the same mark her mother had when she 'drowned' in 1995.

Margaret Blackwood, 82, is the last of the original founding family. Sharp as a tack despite her age, she knows where all the bodies are buried - literally. She's decided it's time for the truth to come out, but someone is killing anyone she talks to.

Dr. Nathan Cross runs the local medical examiner's office. A forensic pathologist who traded Boston trauma for coastal quiet, he notices patterns others miss. His growing friendship with Sarah is complicated by evidence suggesting her father may have been involved in her mother's death.

Librarian Anna Chen maintains the town archives, including records the Blackwoods thought they'd destroyed. She's been quietly building a case against the founding families for twenty years. Now someone has noticed her research.

Reverend Thomas Grey came to Raven's Crossing to escape his past in Chicago. He took confessions from dying men that implicated powerful people. Now those people want to know what he knows.

Reporter Jamie Vasquez works for the Raven's Crossing Gazette, the local paper that hasn't broken a real story in decades. She's discovered financial irregularities in the town accounts that lead to offshore accounts and a smuggling operation that's been running since Prohibition.

Former Judge Eleanor Prescott knows every crime that was buried, every deal that was made, every hand that was shaken. Alzheimer's is stealing her memories, and her granddaughter is racing to record her lucid moments before they're gone forever.
